mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_AUTOFIX (INQUIRY_ID, ISSUE_NO, REQUESTED_BY, SOURCE, TITLE, SIGNATURE) VALUES (#{inquiryId}, #{issueNo}, #{requestedBy}, COALESCE(#{source}, 'INQUIRY'), #{title}, #{signature})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_AUTOFIX WHERE INS_DAY >= (DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_AUTOFIX WHERE 1=1 AND INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} AND STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'WORKING', 'READY')
mapper.sql: A.ID AS "id" ,A.INQUIRY_ID AS "inquiryId" ,A.ISSUE_NO AS "issueNo" ,A.PR_NO AS "prNo" ,A.BRANCH AS "branch" ,A.STATUS AS "status" ,A.SUMMARY AS "summary" ,A.FILES AS "files" ,A.ERROR AS "error" ,A.RUN_URL AS "runUrl" ,A.SOURCE AS "source" ,A.TITLE AS "title" ,I.TITLE AS "inquiryTitle" ,I.AI_SUMMARY AS "inquirySummary" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM A.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM A.UPD_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "updAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_AUTOFIX A LEFT JOIN T_INQUIRY I ON I.ID = A.INQUIRY_ID WHERE A.ID = #{id}
SELECT FROM T_AUTOFIX A LEFT JOIN T_INQUIRY I ON I.ID = A.INQUIRY_ID WHERE A.ISSUE_NO = #{issueNo}
SELECT FROM T_AUTOFIX A LEFT JOIN T_INQUIRY I ON I.ID = A.INQUIRY_ID ORDER BY A.ID DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_AUTOFIX WHERE STATUS = 'READY'
mapper.update: UPDATE T_AUTOFIX SET STATUS = #{status} ,PR_NO = COALESCE(#{prNo}, PR_NO) ,BRANCH = COALESCE(#{branch}, BRANCH) ,SUMMARY = COALESCE(#{summary}, SUMMARY) ,FILES = COALESCE(#{files}, FILES) ,ERROR = #{error} ,RUN_URL = COALESCE(#{runUrl}, RUN_URL) ,UPD_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ISSUE_NO = #{issueNo} AND STATUS NOT IN ('MERGED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id" ,STATUS AS "status" ,SUMMARY AS "summary" ,FINDINGS_JSON AS "findingsJson" FROM T_QA_RUN WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS IN ('WARN', 'FAIL') AND INS_DAY >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 days' ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SERVICE AS "service" ,ACTION AS "action" ,COUNT(*) AS "fails" ,MAX(STATUS_CODE) AS "statusCode" ,(ARRAY_AGG(ERROR_MSG ORDER BY CALLED_AT DESC))[1] AS "lastError" FROM T_API_CALL_LOG WHERE 1=1 AND SUCCESS_YN = 'N' AND CALLED_AT >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 days' GROUP BY SERVICE, ACTION ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT JOB_NAME AS "job" ,COUNT(*) AS "fails" ,(ARRAY_AGG(MESSAGE ORDER BY ID DESC))[1] AS "lastMessage" FROM T_JOB_RUN WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS IN ('FAIL', 'PARTIAL') AND STARTED_AT >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 days' GROUP BY JOB_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT DISTINCT SIGNATURE FROM T_AUTOFIX WHERE 1=1 AND SIGNATURE IS NOT NULL AND INS_DAY >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_AUTOFIX WHERE STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'WORKING', 'READY')
